text:
Iris (Marketing): AuroraLabs agreed to a customer story. Need interview, quote approval, legal opt-in, and webinar mention. Can we map owners?
Ben (PMM): I'll own the hero stat. Recommend focusing on cost-per-inference and p95 latency.
Sam (Content): I'll write interview guide and social copy. Keep soundbites short.
Rohit (CSM): Customer can do a 30m interview Fri morning. They want to review any quote before publish.
Lena (Legal): Send opt-in and any perf snapshots to legal@redwood. We'll need method notes.
Vik (Sales): After webinar route leads -> tag 'aurora-spotlight' -> attended >= 40% -> AE queue 'LaunchPool'.
Marta (AuroraLabs): Fri morning works. We'll share an anonymized metric snippet and one dashboard screenshot. We request 3 business days internal review and a one-week embargo.
calendar-bot: Event created: "AuroraLabs case interview" Fri 09:30 - attendees: Iris, Sam, Rohit, Marta.
Ben (PMM): Draft hero: 'Reduced p95 latency by 40% and lowered per-call cost by 25% (internal tests, May 2026)'. Adding parenthetical date.
Sam (Content): Asset list: hero stat, one-liner quote, 3 social teasers, hero graphic, raw transcript, benchmark appendix PDF. Will watermark screenshot.
Rohit (CSM): I'll upload their metrics sheet to the private drive and cc Lena.
Lena (Legal): Once I get the sheet and method blurb, I'll review in 24-48h. If numbers are disputed we'll soft-launch with relative language.
Iris (Marketing): Timeline: interview Fri, legal signoff early next week, assets staged by next Wed, publish + webinar mention two weeks after. If embargo confirmed, schedule publish accordingly.
Vik (Sales): Make sure webinar CTA captures role and company size for routing.
Marta (AuroraLabs): Confirmed: we'll anonymize IDs and approve one screenshot. We'll confirm embargo in the invite thread.
Iris (Marketing): Thanks team. Closing loop: Ben finalizes hero stat, Rohit uploads metrics, Lena reviews, Sam drafts assets. Will post draft announcement after legal signoff.
